summary: LOPF: GL 4015 Transfer Savings to Reserve (interfund transfer SAV to RES) and Kat's Savings rules for the 9/10/2026 $42,700 + $42,700 transfer lines (both cash sides; the 2025 half flagged for its missing authorization). Configuration only; nothing posts.

preflight.name: LOPF has SAV and RES funds
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM account_funds WHERE community_id = 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002' AND fund_code IN ('SAV','RES')

preflight.name: 4015 is free
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM chart_of_accounts WHERE community_id = 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002' AND account_number = '4015'

preflight.name: 1100 and 1110 exist
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM chart_of_accounts WHERE community_id = 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002' AND account_number IN ('1100','1110')

preflight.name: the LOPF reconciliation automation row exists without a 4015 rule
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM community_accounting_automation WHERE community_id = 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002' AND process = 'bank_reconciliation' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(settings->'transfer_rules','[]'::jsonb)) r WHERE r->>'account' = '4015')

expected_changes: chart_of_accounts: 4015 Transfer Savings to Reserve added (SAV fund, interfund_transfer from SAV to RES).
community_accounting_automation: two Savings transfer rules added to LOPF's bank reconciliation settings.
No journal entry, run, statement or balance changes.

verify.name: 4015 is an interfund transfer from SAV to RES
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM chart_of_accounts c JOIN account_funds f ON f.id = c.interfund_from_fund_id JOIN account_funds t ON t.id = c.interfund_to_fund_id WHERE c.community_id = 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002' AND c.account_number = '4015' AND c.account_subtype = 'interfund_transfer' AND f.fund_code = 'SAV' AND t.fund_code = 'RES'

verify.name: two 4015 rules on Savings, the 2025 one flagged
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM community_accounting_automation, jsonb_array_elements(settings->'transfer_rules') r WHERE community_id = 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002' AND process = 'bank_reconciliation' AND r->>'account' = '4015' AND r->>'bank_account_id' = '8467a5a4-1291-4d94-8c28-b5f85fd862e0' AND r->>'counter_cash_account' = '1110'

verify.name: the 2025 rule carries the authorization flag
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM community_accounting_automation, jsonb_array_elements(settings->'transfer_rules') r WHERE community_id = 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002' AND process = 'bank_reconciliation' AND r->>'match' = '^2025 Transfer$' AND r->>'flag' IS NOT NULL
